description: Supervision pump operation specifies information for monitoring the pump operation.

AccessoryLiquidFlow.description: This attribute indicates a problem with the accessory liquid flow, e.g. the buffer fluid flow or operating fluid flow.
AccessoryLiquidFlow.title: AccessoryLiquidFlow

AccessoryLiquidHigh.description: This attribute indicates a high limited accessory liquid, e.g. the buffer fluid or operating fluid.
AccessoryLiquidHigh.title: AccessoryLiquidHigh

AccessoryLiquidLow.description: This attribute indicates a low limited accessory liquid, e.g. the buffer fluid or operating fluid.
AccessoryLiquidLow.title: AccessoryLiquidLow

AccessoryLiquidOverheat.description: This attribute indicates an overheating of the accessory liquid, e.g. the buffer fluid or operating fluid.
AccessoryLiquidOverheat.title: AccessoryLiquidOverheat

AccessoryLiquidPressure.description: This attribute indicates an abnormal pressure of the accessory liquid, e.g. the buffer fluid pressure or operating fluid pressure.
AccessoryLiquidPressure.title: AccessoryLiquidPressure

AmbientTemperature.description: This attribute indicates an abnormal ambient temperature.
AmbientTemperature.title: AmbientTemperature

CaseOverheat.description: This attribute indicates an overheating of the case.
CaseOverheat.title: CaseOverheat

ControllerOverheat.description: This attribute indicates an overheating of a controller.
ControllerOverheat.title: ControllerOverheat

ConverterOverheat.description: This property indicates an overheating of a converter.
ConverterOverheat.title: ConverterOverheat

CoolantFlow.description: This attribute indicates a problem with the coolant flow.
CoolantFlow.title: CoolantFlow

CoolantHigh.description: This attribute indicates that the coolant is high limited.
CoolantHigh.title: CoolantHigh

CoolantLow.description: This attribute indicates that the coolant is low limited.
CoolantLow.title: CoolantLow

CoolantOverheat.description: This attribute indicates an overheating of the coolant liquid.
CoolantOverheat.title: CoolantOverheat

Deceleration.description: This attribute indicates a deceleration of a pump.
Deceleration.title: Deceleration

DirtyImpeller.description: This attribute indicates a dirty impeller.
DirtyImpeller.title: DirtyImpeller

DriveOverheat.description: This attribute indicates an overheating of a drive.
DriveOverheat.title: DriveOverheat

GeneratorOperation.description: This attribute indicates that the pump is working as a generator (in flow).
GeneratorOperation.title: GeneratorOperation

Leakage.description: This attribute indicates a leakage problem, e.g. leakage of the mechanical seal.
Leakage.title: Leakage

Lubricant.description: This attribute indicates a problem with the lubricant.
Lubricant.title: Lubricant

MaximumNumberStarts.description: This attribute indicates that the maximum number of pump start cycles is exceeded.
MaximumNumberStarts.title: MaximumNumberStarts

MaximumOperationTime.description: This attribute indicates that the maximum time of pump operation is exceeded.
MaximumOperationTime.title: MaximumOperationTime

MaximumStartsAtTime.description: This attribute indicates that the maximum number of pump start cycles per timespan is exceeded.
MaximumStartsAtTime.title: MaximumStartsAtTime

MotorHumidity.description: This attribute indicates unacceptable humidity in the motor.
MotorHumidity.title: MotorHumidity

MotorOverheat.description: This attribute indicates an overheating of a motor.
MotorOverheat.title: MotorOverheat

OperationFault.description: This attribute indicates a generic operation problem of a pump.
OperationFault.title: OperationFault

OverLoad.description: This attribute indicates an over load.
OverLoad.title: OverLoad

OverSpeed.description: This attribute indicates that the pump operates over normal speed.
OverSpeed.title: OverSpeed

PartialLoad.description: This attribute indicates a partial load.
PartialLoad.title: PartialLoad

Synchronisation.description: This attribute indicates a synchronization problem of a pump.
Synchronisation.title: Synchronisation

TMSFailure.description: This attribute indicates a failure of the temperature management system.
TMSFailure.title: TMSFailure

TemperatureFault.description: This attribute indicates a generic temperature problem of a pump.
TemperatureFault.title: TemperatureFault

TimeOut.description: This attribute indicates a start up time out.
TimeOut.title: TimeOut

TorqueLimit.description: This attribute indicates a limitation problem of a pump.
TorqueLimit.title: TorqueLimit

TurbineOperation.description: This attribute indicates that the pump is working as a turbine (reverse flow).
TurbineOperation.title: TurbineOperation

UnderSpeed.description: This attribute indicates that the pump operates under normal speed.
UnderSpeed.title: UnderSpeed

VelocityLimit.description: This attribute indicates a limitation problem of a pump.
VelocityLimit.title: VelocityLimit

WearReserveExhausted.description: This attribute indicates that the wear reserve of the pump is exhausted.
WearReserveExhausted.title: WearReserveExhausted
